dedupe_keys.name: california energy commission solar equipment lists pv modules inverters batteries storage systems and meters meeting safety and performance standards

description: The Solar Equipment Lists of the California Energy Commission list photovoltaic modules, inverters including smart inverters, batteries, energy storage systems, meters, power control systems and related equipment that manufacturers report as meeting national safety and performance standards. The program page read on 2026-09-26 states that the lists are updated three times a month, on or after the 1st, 11th and 21st, and that the active lists can be viewed or downloaded from the Solar Equipment Lists application. Submissions are reviewed by the Commission, but manufacturers' self-reported information is not confirmed, and the Commission makes no warranty on safety, performance or durability. The lists began under Senate Bill 1 of 2006 for the California Solar Initiative and now support incentive programs, utility interconnection under electric Rule 21 including smart inverter integration, and research and modelling. Coverage is equipment sold into California, which in practice covers much of the US market. No licence is stated on the page read. Caveats: ratings are self-reported test values. Simulation uses are module and inverter parameters for PV performance and hosting capacity models and smart-inverter settings in distribution studies. Related records: data-lbnl-tracking-the-sun links installed systems to equipment.
